title: What is BEAR (Alpha)?
text: BEAR (Alpha) is a horror game on Roblox. A user called Cheedaman made it in 2019. Today it is a very famous game: it has more than three hundred million visits.

In every match there are two groups. One player is the Bear and the other players are the survivors. The Bear is big, fast and dangerous. It has a red light around it, so the survivors can see it in the dark.

The survivors have one mission: escape from the Bear. They need to run, hide and work as a team. On a computer, a player holds down the Shift key to run faster. If the Bear catches a survivor, that player loses.
Every match has a time limit. If the time ends and some survivors are still alive, they win. If the Bear catches everyone, the Bear wins.
The game is a little scary, but it is also a lot of fun. It is perfect to play with friends!
